aviation_incidents.headline: 土耳其空軍AS-532直升機訓練時墜毀 5名軍人全數罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 土耳其空軍一架AS-532直升機11月24日在艾斯基瑟希爾省執行訓練時墜毀，機上5名軍人全部罹難。搜救人員尋獲殘骸，墜毀原因仍不明。11月12日另有一架S-70軍用直升機在馬拉蒂亞省墜毀，4名軍人罹難。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Turkish Air Force AS532 helicopter crashes during training, killing five soldiers
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Turkish Air Force AS532 helicopter crashed during a training flight in Eskisehir Province on November 24, killing all five soldiers aboard. Search teams found the wreckage, but the cause remains unknown. A separate S-70 military helicopter crash in Malatya Province killed four soldiers on November 12.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 波蘭通報俄羅斯無人機短暫進入領空 北約準備增派預警機
taiwan_aviation.summary: 波蘭軍方表示，11月23日晚間一架俄羅斯無人機短暫進入波蘭領空，當時俄羅斯正攻擊烏克蘭西部。波蘭副國防部長帕韋烏・扎萊夫斯基認為進入領空是蓄意行為；北約在近期一連串領空事件後，正準備增派空中預警機支援波蘭。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Poland reports brief Russian drone incursion; NATO prepares early warning support
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Poland's military said a Russian drone briefly entered Polish airspace late on November 23 while Russia was attacking western Ukraine. Deputy Defence Minister Paweł Zalewski said he believed the incursion was deliberate. NATO is preparing additional airborne early warning support for Poland after a series of airspace incidents.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣國防部通報1架共機及9艘共艦 國軍監控應處
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部表示，11月24日上午6時至25日上午6時偵獲1架中國軍機侵擾臺灣東部空域，另偵獲9艘中國軍艦。國軍運用執勤飛機、艦艇及岸置飛彈系統監控應處。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan reports one Chinese military aircraft and nine warships; forces monitor activity
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's defence ministry said it detected one Chinese military aircraft in airspace east of Taiwan and nine Chinese warships during the 24 hours from 6 a.m. on November 24 to 6 a.m. on November 25. Taiwan's forces used aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems to monitor and respond.

international_aviation.headline: 美國陸軍擬恢復華盛頓國家機場附近直升機訓練 仍待航空主管機關核准
international_aviation.summary: 美國陸軍計畫最快12月6日當週恢復華盛頓國家機場附近直升機訓練，但須經美國聯邦航空總署核准，陸軍尚未正式申請。訓練自2025年5月暫停，當時一架陸軍黑鷹過於接近數架民航機。2025年1月29日，陸軍黑鷹與美國航空地區客機相撞，造成67人罹難。陸軍已為UH-60黑鷹機隊加裝ADS-B Out並更換兩款高度表；工會及部分國會議員反對恢復訓練。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Army plans to resume helicopter training near Washington National Airport, pending approval
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Army plans to resume helicopter training near Washington National Airport as early as the week of December 6, but needs Federal Aviation Administration approval and has not submitted a formal request. Training has been suspended since May 2025, when an Army Black Hawk flew too close to several commercial aircraft. On January 29, 2025, an Army Black Hawk collided with an American Airlines regional jet, killing 67 people. The Army has installed ADS-B Out on its UH-60 Black Hawk fleet and replaced two altimeter models. Unions and some lawmakers oppose the restart.

international_aviation.headline: 以色列同意flydubai恢復杜拜至特拉維夫航班 仍待安全機關核准
international_aviation.summary: 以色列交通部長同意flydubai恢復杜拜至特拉維夫航班，但仍須以色列安全機關核准，復飛日期尚未公布，航空公司正與相關機關協調。一班飛往特拉維夫的航班9月30日因機上安全事件轉降後，flydubai暫停該航線。
international_aviation.headline_en: Israel approves resumption of flydubai's Dubai–Tel Aviv flights pending security clearance
international_aviation.summary_en: Israel's transport minister approved the resumption of flydubai flights from Dubai to Tel Aviv, subject to Israeli security clearance. No restart date has been announced, and the airline is coordinating with the authorities. Flydubai suspended the route after a Tel Aviv-bound flight diverted on September 30 following an onboard security incident.

international_aviation.headline: 岡山桃太郎機場演練降落事故救援 愛爾蘭航空擬改裝10架A330並首次設豪華經濟艙 Schiebel展示Camcopter S-100搭載小型無人機
international_aviation.summary: 岡山桃太郎機場11月24日模擬客機降落事故，演練傷患救援、檢傷分類及初期應變。愛爾蘭航空宣布改裝10架A330並首次設置豪華經濟艙，首架改裝客機預計自2027年10月1日起執飛部分都柏林至紐約甘迺迪機場航班。Schiebel與Osiris Poland在奧地利完成Camcopter S-100搭載小型無人機的概念驗證展示。
international_aviation.headline_en: Okayama Airport rehearses landing accident response; Aer Lingus plans premium economy on 10 A330s; Schiebel demonstrates drone-carrying Camcopter S-100
international_aviation.summary_en: Okayama Momotaro Airport held a landing accident drill on November 24, rehearsing casualty rescue, triage and the initial response. Aer Lingus plans to retrofit 10 Airbus A330s and introduce its first premium economy cabin; the first refurbished aircraft is scheduled for selected Dublin–New York JFK flights from October 1, 2027. Schiebel and Osiris Poland completed a proof-of-concept demonstration in Austria of a Camcopter S-100 carrying a small drone.

international_aviation.headline: 瑞安航空取消5個目的地全部航班 全面退出土耳其與塞爾維亞
international_aviation.summary: 瑞安航空2026年10月取消飛往土耳其達拉曼、博德魯姆，希臘沃洛斯、卡拉馬塔及塞爾維亞尼什的所有航班，全面退出土耳其與塞爾維亞。最後航班於10月23日至24日執飛；削減並非季節性調整，2027年不會恢復，未來部分市場仍可能重返。
international_aviation.headline_en: Ryanair cancels flights to five destinations and exits Turkey and Serbia
international_aviation.summary_en: Ryanair cancelled all flights to five destinations in October 2026: Dalaman and Bodrum in Turkey, Volos and Kalamata in Greece, and Nis in Serbia. Its last flights operated on October 23 and 24, and it has exited Turkey and Serbia entirely. The cuts are not seasonal and the markets will not return in 2027, although some could return later.

international_aviation.headline: Schiebel展示Camcopter S-100空中釋放無人機 廈門航空簽約採購50架波音737 MAX 8 俄軍機接近鬱陵島 南韓短暫發布避難警報
international_aviation.summary: Schiebel在奧地利展示Camcopter S-100無人直升機從空中釋放小型無人機。中國南方航空11月24日公告，其持有55%股權的廈門航空已簽約購買50架波音737 MAX 8，目錄價合計約74億美元，預計2031年至2034年分批交付，仍待中國主管機關與股東核准。南韓軍方通報，11月24日多架俄軍機進入南韓防空識別區並接近鬱陵島，當局一度要求居民就地避難，約3分鐘後解除警報。
international_aviation.headline_en: Schiebel demonstrates airborne drone launch; Xiamen Airlines signs for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets; South Korea briefly issues shelter alert
international_aviation.summary_en: Schiebel demonstrated an airborne Camcopter S-100 releasing a small drone in Austria. China Southern Airlines said on November 24 that its 55%-owned subsidiary Xiamen Airlines had signed to buy 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets, with a combined list price of about $7.4 billion. Deliveries are planned for 2031 to 2034, subject to Chinese regulatory and shareholder approval. South Korea's military said several Russian aircraft entered its air defence identification zone and approached Ulleung Island on November 24. Authorities lifted a shelter alert for island residents about three minutes after issuing it.

international_aviation.headline: 南韓空軍首架Embraer C-390運輸機飛抵首爾空軍基地 預計12月正式交機
international_aviation.summary: 南韓空軍採購的首架Embraer C-390 Millennium運輸機11月23日飛抵城南市首爾空軍基地，機身已有南韓空軍標誌，但仍掛巴西測試註冊號PT-ZNA，尚未正式交付。首架預計12月交機，其餘兩架預計2027年底前交付；空軍與Embraer尚未公布飛抵消息。
international_aviation.headline_en: South Korea's first Embraer C-390 reaches Seoul Air Base ahead of expected December handover
international_aviation.summary_en: The first Embraer C-390 Millennium built for the South Korean Air Force landed at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam on November 23. It bears South Korean Air Force markings but retains Brazilian test registration PT-ZNA and has not been formally delivered. Handover is expected in December, with the remaining two aircraft expected by the end of 2027. The air force and Embraer had not announced the arrival at the time.
